decisions.reason: A consumer superfood drink mix sits far outside the firm's waste-to-energy engineering focus, and with no archived pages after 2019 it looks like a side line a small startup would cut to save resources.
The modular plant extensions were only ever mentioned, never featured, and with the website going dark after 2019 the firm will probably fold them into its main plant lines or drop them.
The WASTX Oil plant was a flagship product with its own page and a dedicated launch announcement, so it is core to the firm despite its apparent difficulties.
The WASTX Plastic plant gained its own page in 2019 and targets a growing plastic-waste market, making it a core technology the firm would likely keep.
